lead: Burst cadence (capture plan item 1, 28 Sep rescope)
tracedBy: Operator-run source check (external report below); lead re-read two operands and compared with the site model
question: Does the site's burst cadence (rounds at the within-burst rate, then a pause filling a 60/BurstsPerMinute cycle) match source for the nine burst weapons, and is a recording still needed?

sourceFacts.fields: Class_35259f6b Field_f8822efa/Field_14c4a054 RateOfFire, Field_f8822efa/Field_5bd8006c RateOfFireForBurst, Field_f8822efa/Field_2320e742 BurstsPerMinute; Field_58d70acb/Field_ca2ec42a rounds per burst (probable NumberOfBulletsPerBurst).
sourceFacts.grtcps: Source has a burst attachment branch (BurstFireReplace/BurstFireActive, base mode single, BPM 0, rounds 3); not offered in game (operator, 28 Sep).

operatorObservations: M16A4 and GRT-BC show about 33 ms extra delay after each burst, matching 60000/BPM - N*60000/R (33.334 / 33.334 ms).
The six weapons with BPM 0 show no burst delay in recordings, matching the site's back-to-back model.
The earlier SL9 mismatch came from rounded values and 60 fps timing; the source value stands (effective 654.544 RPM).
GRT-CPS burst is not available in game.

siteComparison.model: sim/core.js shotIntervalAfter: pause = max(normal interval, 60/BPM - (N-1) x within-burst interval); same formula as the report.
siteComparison.agreement: burstRounds and burstBurstsPerMinute match source on all nine.
siteComparison.precisionDefect: data/weapons.json stores rounded burstRpm: GRT-BC 830 (source 830.768982), SL9 771 (source 771.427979). Within-burst interval GRT-BC 72.289 -> 72.222 ms, SL9 77.821 -> 77.778 ms; post-burst gap GRT-BC 105.289 -> 105.557 ms, SL9 99.957 -> 100.000 ms. Sustained burst RPM is unchanged (fixed by BPM); TTK changes by under 1 ms.

unresolved: Native burst scheduling is not decoded; the model is supported by source values and operator recordings.
siteImpact: No cadence model change. Operator review: store source precision for burstRpm (GRT-BC 830.769, SL9 771.428). The burst capture is closed.

evidence.note: receipt-v2.json holds the 47 raw scalar checks and branch traces; receipt.json and roster-census.json are superseded intermediates.
